pipeline_difference_notes: Heinsfeld pretrained autoencoder on full N=1035 pooled prior to CV split; our study evaluates N=854 with strictly in-fold training.
Original paper only evaluated random 10-fold CV; our matched LOSO evaluation reveals drop to 66.04%.
Abraham evaluated leave-center-out with site covariate regression; our LR LOSO yields 65.69% accuracy.
Parisot used population GCN with phenotypic acquisition edges; our study compares matched random-CV on CC200 connectomes.
Eslami evaluated ASD-DiagNet with data augmentation; our matched random-CV baseline yields 71.43% on clean data.
Kan evaluated Brain Network Transformer under LOSO; our top tabular/classical model (Random Forest) achieves 0.7003.
Nielsen evaluated leave-one-site-out classification on functional connectivity across 16 ABIDE sites.

Akter trained classifiers on items A1-A10 that deterministically sum to define the target screening label (Tautology Index = 0.8398); clean demographics-only accuracy drops to 73.76% majority baseline.

Hossain reported 100% accuracy using AQ-10 items with global imputation; our matched item evaluation replicates near 100% (99.54%), but clean demographics-only AUROC is 0.4473 (Tautology Index = 1.1054 raw, clipped 1.0000).
Ehsan evaluated toddler screening items that deterministically define diagnosis (cutoff >= 3); clean demographic AUROC drops to 0.5527.
